title: Chapter 670
paragraphs: Chapter 670
670. Meeting another friend, Dante (3)
The friend I hadn't seen in a long time had the same face. His handshake was firmer than before, Jin could feel the past three years of Dante from it.
"It's been a while, you've come back stronger."
"I thought you would look a bit worn out due to your busy schedule. But you have become like an iron man, Dante."
"If I can't even do this, I wouldn't deserve to be the lord of Geomhwangseong."
"I was too busy after returning that I couldn't come to see you first."
"Everyone knows the incredible things you've accomplished as soon as you finished your retreat. I've also been extremely busy until a few days ago, so don't worry about it."
The two stared at each other silently for a while.

Although they couldn't spend time together over the past three years, they both persevered with the same spirit in their own places. They seemed to understand how solid and deep each other's past time had been without speaking.
"Ah! My apologies for the late introduction, Princess, Quikantel, and Latree. I am Dante Hairan, the Lord of Geomhwangseong."
"Why are you acting awkward, Lord Dante? It's not like we've just met."
"Yeah, what's with the awkwardness? Are you going to get sick from eating?"
At Yuriya and Quikantel's response, Dante scratched the back of his head awkwardly.
"I wanted to formally introduce myself to the princess once. It seems I overdid it a bit."
Bubbling.
The seafood soup was boiling. As Yuriya poured the seafood soup into an empty bowl and first offered it to Dante, the meal began.
Dante already knew most of the events that had occurred after Jin's return. Every time an incident happened, Kashmir sent a person to inform him.
"So... the Veradin Kingdom... has it completely forgotten us? To be the victim of such a dirty experiment. Using the Incense Burner, how can they do that to their next head of household and child!"
However, he was hearing about Veradin's condition for the first time today. Jin patted Dante's shoulder as he trembled in anger.
He had known from a long time ago that Veradin was doomed to fall apart, but hearing about the situation from Jin's mouth made him feel as if poison was rising in his heart.
"Zipfel. From those damned bastards... someday, we will surely save our friends."
"Yes, we will do that, Dante."
"Until we bring down the demons, I will control my anger. Just like you, I will use them until I can, and when the job is over, I will break them down mercilessly."
Just as Jin had learned the value of 'moderation' from Ron and Dante.
Dante was also learning the necessity of 'domination' from Jin.
If it was the old Dante, he would never have joined hands with the ones who turned his friend into a miserable experiment, even if it meant death. But now it wasn't.
He had many lives on his shoulders. The world he saw as the Lord of Geomhwangseong and the Subjeong of the Empire showed a completely different aspect from when he was a small head of household.
"Sometimes you have to use your enemies, sometimes you have to retreat, and sometimes you have to do things you don't want to do.
Without it, he couldn't save the numerous vassals and people who only looked at him, and the world.
'You're becoming like Lord Ron, Dante.'
His face always looked like his gentle friend, but Dante had definitely changed.
He had started walking not the path of a small lord, but the path of an emperor.
An emperor who is the strictest to himself and will never be corrupt.
Jin was proud of the fact that Dante was becoming such a person.

And that appearance was what Ron wanted most from Dante during his lifetime. His grandson, who was always straight and full of the spirit of fighting evil at any moment, was surely lovable but always worrying.
Jin was speaking to Ron in his heart. Now, it seems you can watch with a relaxed and joyful heart.
"But, Jin."
"Why?"
"I've been wondering since earlier, what's the reason you came in disguise? It doesn't seem to be just for the leisure of the princess."
"There are guys in the royal family who want to kill you."
"Unless Zipfel gives such a person, it would be impossible. Zipfel has no reason to do that now, right?"
"It wasn't Zipfel, but the Garden of Swords sent out the assassin."
Dante's pupils narrowed.
"The Garden of Swords...?"
"Yeah, the royal family betrayed Zipfel and sided with Rosa. It's something we confirmed through Valeria. Did you know anything about it?"
"Shamefully, I didn't know at all."
"The betrayed party didn't know either. Zipfel didn't know that the royal family was colluding with the Garden of Swords."
Even after Jin revealed the betrayal, Zipfel had not rashly purged the royal family.
Considering the situation, they first had to determine how much information they got from them and informed Runcandel.
"Valeria said it seemed like you were in danger. We're guessing Joshua provided the assassin to the royal family."

"If it's a knight of the highest level strengthened by chaos and the ability of a prophet, it wouldn't have been a dreamlike story for the royal family to assassinate me. The reason the Garden of Swords wants to get rid of me would be because it's awkward for me to help you."
"That's why I came in disguise after a long time. I also brought our princess here."
Of course, the reason Jin brought Yuria in this dangerous situation was not just to give her pleasant memories.
"......You're thinking of using the princess's authority to find the assassin?"
"Exactly."
Dante was about to suggest that it might be too dangerous to bring the young princess to such a place, but after looking at Jin, he decided against it.
It seemed doubtful whether Yuria could be in danger no matter who the enemy sent, as long as he and Jin were there.
"It seemed like you wanted to say something."
"I think it won't be a problem upon reflection. Unless the assassins are demons or the old swords of Runcandel."
"Even if it's Duke Fadler, Yuria won't get hurt. Especially since you're here too."
"So, what should we do now?"

"There is very little information except that the Garden of Swords gave the assassin to Ailan Vermont. So first, summon all possible personnel to the imperial city. It would be best to check if there's anyone suspicious among them."
"Don't tell me you want to ask everyone if there's a traitor here?"
Jin nodded.
"It's an investigation method only possible because the princess is here."

"Me, Yuria, Latree, and Quintel need to attend the imperial city meeting. As it is a place where the empire's highest representatives gather, we need a justification to participate. What I had in mind was……."

"Jin, I'm currently no different from the empire's only supreme ruler. Even the deceased Amir Vermont did not have more power than me. So, I don't need any justification, all the servants of the empire should rush over as soon as I call."
"Oh, I momentarily forgot that you've changed. There was no need to think hard about justification."
"I'm curious, though. What justification were you thinking of?"

"I was thinking of saying that you happened to save some dragons in the contaminated area. So they came to repay their gratitude. Because you have often gone on suppression missions alone without knights."
"That justification you thought of is somewhat... lacking in plausibility. The existence of dragons without affiliation in the current world is extremely rare."
"Well, I'm glad it's not needed."
"But if someone dares to ask about our origin, I'll say that first."
"If the traitor is in the capital and that fact is immediately revealed, there will be no need to lie then."
The meal was over.
Outside, a carriage was prepared, and the party immediately headed to the imperial city.

"Tell all servants in the capital who are on standby to gather in the imperial city's first meeting room within two hours. Excluding average knights and average magicians who are on a mission, up to class 10 servants, all of them. It's an emergency assembly. Anyone who is even a second late will be severely punished."
"Yes, your Highness!"
The order dropped across the capital in an instant.
"Has the Highness ever summoned us like this?"

"He can't stand us resting for even a moment, so he tells us to work until we drop dead for the people and the empire, but what on earth is the reason for leaving the work to the deputy and calling us?"
"What the hell is this late at night! I'm so anxious, I could die. Is he going to overthrow Crown Prince Kuron and ascend the throne himself?"

"It's only this much because even Crown Prince Kuron begged us to be considerate with his young voice... If the Lord of the Sword Imperial City ascends the throne, we are confirmed to die from overwork...!"

"Whatever it is, let's go quickly and bow down, if we show even a hint of displeasure, it'll be the end. You all know, right? Remember what happened to Count Magl last time when he grumbled about having a lot of work."
Thus, the vassals who were afraid of Dante clung to their melting livers, and the vassals who admired Dante came to the palace filled with resolve.
"It's an emergency summons from Lord Dante. There must be a serious matter."
"Everyone, don't show your tiredness, no one in the empire can be more distressed than Lord Dante."
Carriages and horses were entering the palace without rest.
Before even two hours had passed, about a thousand vassals had gathered in the meeting room.
"Has everyone arrived?"
The sight that the vassals saw was Dante sitting on the throne, and four unfamiliar faces standing behind him.
No one recognized that Jin and his party were disguised.
"Yes, Lord Dante!"
"Yes, sir!"
Despite so many vassals gathered, they did not dare exchange glances in front of Dante.
They had seen many who got into trouble just for rolling their eyes.
'No one dares to ask Dante about our identities. It's as stern as when my father was admitted to the Garden of Swords. But those guys… seem to be expecting something.'
In the midst of the heavy atmosphere that was suffocating, there were groups who carelessly showed anticipation.
They were dignitaries and knights from Hairan, and the reason they sparkled their eyes was because of Quikantel, who was standing behind Dante in disguise.
'Could it be that the Lord has finally found his true person!'
'It's to introduce the true person and their family, if not. No… it may not be. It can't be. He's not the kind to summon the vassals urgently for personal matters….'
Sadly, they soon turned gloomy and corrected their gazes.
The knights of Hairan knew well how lonely and harsh times Dante was spending, so they were desperately hoping for the true person who would provide some comfort for him.
Dante stood up from his seat.
"Since everyone is busy, I will speak straightforwardly. The reason I've gathered you all now is because there is a traitor within the empire."
"How could this be!"

"Do not open your mouth until I permit. Let's finish quickly so everyone can go back to contributing to the normalization of the empire. From now on, you should only answer my questions with 'yes or no.' Now, let's start with the first question."
Dante looked at the vassals with fiercely strict eyes.
"Is there anyone among you who intends to harm me or knows of such plans?"
"No, sir!"
The vassals answered, and Dante waited for Yuriya's signal.
Yuriya observed the vassals for a few minutes and gently pricked Dante's back seven times.
It meant that seven of them had lied.
